hero.title: Iibsiga iyo <stone>gaadiidka</stone> oo horumarinaya ganacsigaaga <stone>Shiinaha ilaa Afrika.</stone>
hero.subtitle: Lammaanaha aad ku kalsoon tahay ee iibsiga, gaadiidka, iyo xalalka soo saarista. Waxaan ka soo iibineynaa alaabooyinka tayo leh Shiinaha oo aan si fudud ugu keenno suuqyada Afrika.

sourcing.description: Waxaan ku aqoonsaneynaa oo ku xireynaa soo saarayaasha iyo soo qaadayaasha kalsooni leh ee Shiinaha ee u dhigma baahiyahaaga gaarka ah ee alaabta.

quality.title: Hubinta tayada
quality.description: Baaritaanada adag ee tayada iyo habka xaqiijinta si loo hubiyo in alaabtu ay buuxiso heerarka caalamiga ah ka hor raridda.

purchasing.title: Maaraynta iibsiga
purchasing.description: Maaraynta dhammaystiran ee dalabyada iibsiga, habaynta lacag bixinta, iyo isku-dubaridka soo qaadayaasha magacaaga.

negotiation.title: Wada hadallada qiimaha
negotiation.description: Adeegyada khibradda leh ee wada hadallada si aad u hesho qiimaha ugu wanaagsan iyo shuruudaha u fiican baahiyaha iibsigaaga.

about.title: Naga saabsan A&A
about.subtitle: Buundooyinka xiriirinta, dhisida iskaashiyada
about.description: A&A waa shirkad hogaaminaysa iibsiga iyo gaadiidka oo ku takhasustay jidadka ganacsiga Shiinaha-Afrika. Iyada oo leh aqoon dheer oo ku saabsan iibsashada, raridda, iyo maaraynta soo saarista, waxaan ka caawineynaa ganacsiyada inay helaan alaabooyin tayo leh oo ka yimid Shiinaha oo si hufan loogu geeyo suuqyada Afrika.
about.missionText: In la fududeeyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah oo kalsooni leh, hufan, iyo qaali ahaan wax ku ool ah oo adeegyada iibsiga iyo gaadiidka oo awood siinaya ganacsiyada inay korodaan oo ay barwaaqoobaan.
about.visionText: Inaan noqono buundada ugu kalsooni badan ee xidhaysa soo saarayaasha Shiinaha iyo suuqyada Afrika, iyagoo dejinaya heerar cusub ee fududeynta ganacsiga iyo adeega macaamiisha.

download.title: Soo deji A&A Store
download.subtitle: Hel aplikeeshanka mobilka ee A&A Store ee Android si aad u maareyso raridyada, dalabyada, iyo qiimayaasha meel kastoo aad joogto.
download.fileNote: Kani waa faylka APK ee app-ka. Android-ku wuxuu ku weydiin karaa inaad browser-ka u oggolaato rakibidda app-kan.

steps.one: Badhanka kore ku soo deji faylka APK.
steps.two: Fur faylka aad soo dejisay. Waxaad ka heli kartaa galka Downloads ama ogeysiiska soo dejinta.
steps.three: Haddii Android-ku ku weydiiyo, browser-ka aad isticmaashay u oggolow rakibidda app-ka (Allow from this source).
steps.four: Raac tilmaamaha shaashadda si aad u dhammaystirto rakibidda.

experience.footerNote: Isku xidhidda himilooyinka. Xuduudaha ka gudub.
experience.heroDescription: Laga bilaabo helidda alaab-qeybiyaha saxda ah ilaa gaarsiinta ugu dambaysa. Waxaan kuu fududaynaynaa iibsiga iyo raridda alaabta Shiinaha.
experience.heroAlt: Markab konteenarro sida oo maraya badda buluugga ah, una taagan ganacsiga Shiinaha iyo Afrika
experience.heroFootnote: Si taxaddar leh loo soo iibsaday. Si kalsooni leh loo keenay.
experience.servicesIntro: Hal lammaane oo kaa caawiya tallaabo kasta. Waxaan isku keennaa dadka, alaabta iyo hababka saxda ah si aan kuu fududayno tallaabadaada xigta.
experience.serviceNote: Laga bilaabo dalabkaaga koowaad ilaa fursaddaada xigta.
experience.networkIntro: Masaafadu yaanay kaa hor istaagin fursadda. Shabakaddayada Shiinaha iyo Afrika waxay kuu soo dhowaysaa alaabta aad u baahan tahay.
experience.seaDescription: Hab ku habboon shixnadaha waaweyn. Waxaan isku dubbaridnaa raridda badda iyo faahfaahinta dhaqaajisa alaabtaada.
experience.airDescription: Raridda hawada ee shixnadaha degdegga ah. Kala hadal shirkadayada jidka ku habboon alaabtaada iyo jadwalkaaga.
experience.routeAlt: Sawir adduunka ah oo muujinaya marinka ganacsiga Shiinaha iyo Afrika

experience.faqTitle: Caddayn yar ayaa wax badan fududaysa.
experience.faqIntro: Ma ku cusub tahay iibsiga Shiinaha? Waxaan halkan u joognaa in tallaabadaada koowaad noqoto mid kalsooni leh.
experience.faq1Question: Ma iga caawin kartaan helidda alaab Shiinaha?
experience.faq1Answer: Haa. Nala wadaag waxa aad raadinayso, tirada iyo shuruudahaaga. Shirkadayadu waxay kaa caawin kartaa helidda alaab-qeybiyeyaal, qiimaha iyo isku dubbaridka iibsiga.
experience.faq2Question: Ma bixisaan raridda hawada iyo badda?
experience.faq2Answer: Waxaan isku dubbaridnaa raridda hawada iyo badda labadaba. Doorashada saxda ahi waxay ku xidhan tahay alaabtaada, baaxadda shixnadda, meesha la geynayo iyo wakhtiga. Nala soo xidhiidh si aan uga wada hadalno jidka iyo qiimaha ku habboon.
experience.faq3Answer: Buuxi foomka hoose ama noogu soo dir farriin WhatsApp. Ku dar faahfaahinta alaabta, tirada iyo meesha laguu geynayo si shirkadayadu ugaala hadasho tallaabooyinka xiga.
experience.faq4Question: Sideen u rakibi karaa app-ka A&A Store?
experience.faq4Answer: A&A Store ka soo deji Google Play adigoo isticmaalaya Android. Bogga soo-dejinta waxaad sidoo kale ka heli kartaa APK iyo tilmaamaha rakibidda.
experience.contactEyebrow: Waxyaabaha waaweyn waxay ka bilaabmaan wada hadal

experience.formIntro: Noo sheeg waxa aad u baahan tahay. Foomkani wuxuu kuu diyaarinayaa iimayl aad noo soo dirto.
experience.videoError: Muuqaalka lama daari karo. Isku day mar kale ama si toos ah u fur.

launch.aboutBody: A&A Store waxa dhisay shirkada EastGate Venture Holdings LLP. A&A Store waxay macaamiisha ka caawinnaa raadinta, iibsiga iyo rarista alaabta Shiinaha.
launch.photoLabel: Shirkada A&A oo shaqada ku jirta.
launch.businessBody: Waxaan kaa caawinnaa raadinta alaabta, iibsiga, hubinta tayada iyo rarista.
launch.faqBody: Jawaabaha su'aalaha ku saabsan app-ka iyo adeegyada A&A halkan ka eeg.

faq1.question: Maxaan ka heli karaa A&A Store?
faq1.answer: Waxaad ka heli kartaa qalabka elektarooniga ah, dharka, qalabka guriga, alaabta quruxda iyo daryeelka, alaabta carruurta iyo qalabka ciyaaraha. Bogga hore waxa kale oo aad ka eegi kartaa qiimo-dhimista maanta.

faq2.question: A&A Store ma ku shaqaynayaa telefoonkayga?
faq2.answer: Haddii aad isticmaasho Android, A&A Store ka soo deji Google Play-ga. Bogga soo dejinta waxa kale oo yaalla faylka APK.

faq3.question: Dalabkayga ma iga caawin kartaan?
faq3.answer: Haa. WhatsApp-kayaga noogu soo dir faahfaahinta dalabkaaga ama alaabta aad rabto. Waxaan kaa caawinaynaa su'aalahaga iibsiga iyo rarista.

faq4.question: A&A ma iga caawin kartaa raadinta alaabta ganacsigayga?
faq4.answer: Haa. Waxaan kaa caawinnaa raadinta alaabta, iibsiga, hubinta tayada iyo soo rarista Shiinaha ilaa Afrika. Foomka hoose noogu sheeg waxa aad u baahan tahay.
